QuestInfo.name: Keol's Order #9
QuestInfo.0: Keol, the pompous working partner of Moren who is as irritable as they come in all of Maple, is giving me a new work request. Better go see what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Moren's coworker Keol told me he received a massive order from The Nautilus, and he needed help completing the order. He then asked me if I could make a mop for him!\n\n#i4001182# #t4001182# #b#c4001182# / 6
QuestInfo.2: Captain Kyrin of The Nautilus must be a neat freak. Otherwise, she wouldn't have purchased that many cleaning products! I wound up making the mop for Keol so he could ship it and other products to The Nautilus.

0.0: It's a new request. Every one of us is so busy these days, that we may have to hire another apprentice, someone who's GOOD. Yes, I should ask her for a recommendation when I deliver this to her.
0.1: Anyway, this time the order came from the The Nautilus. Captain Kyrin came by herself and made a huge purchase on the cleaning tools. It was such a huge order that we are actually short on mops, so we promised her to deliver the rest as soon as we have them ready. I want you to take care of making those mops. What do you think?

yes.0: Here's the request form. You know the drill, right? We need #b6 #t4001182#s#k. Kyrin has quite a temper, so I suggest you start working on this immediately.

no.0: I was starting to wonder if my initial impression of yours was wrong. I guess I was right though.

1.0: Oh, this is much quicker than I thought. Okay, just stack them up there on the side, since mail guy will come soon to pick it up. As for your fee, choose one of the following, since I'm busy right now.

item.0: Are you sure you have all #b6 #t4001182#s#k ready to be sent to The Nautilus?

lost.0: This is preposterous. Unbelievable. How can you not even take care of the purchase order I gave you? What was Moren thinking? Seriously, un-be-lieeevable.
